reviews.name: Sandeep Easwaramangalam
reviews.quote: Pros: *you can book the food/ sadhya even when u make a late decision.. ( most other caterers will not accept last minute booking). * Food is tasty.. Cons: *They provide some curry in disposable single use containers and we will have to return it after washing.. Hope they will stop this practice.
